message: Water is rising fast on Juja Road near Mathare, several houses on our street are flooded and families are moving to higher ground.
Mafuriko makubwa hapa Mathare North! Maji yamefika magotini na watoto hawawezi kutoka shuleni. Tafadhali tuma msaada.
Msee maji imeflood Huruma sides, plot mzima iko kwa maji, watu wanahepa na vitu zao. Situation ni noma!
There is flooding somewhere near the river and the roads are becoming impassable. Not sure exactly where, I am just passing through.
Maji yamejaa huku kwetu vijijini, hatuwezi kuvuka kwenda sokoni. Hakuna majeruhi lakini chakula kinaisha.
Small fire at a food kiosk on Kimathi Street, shopkeepers are putting it out with extinguishers. No one hurt.
Mathare tena! Maji imeingia ploti yetu usiku kucha, vitu zote zimeharibika. Tunahitaji pa kulala.
Tangu asubuhi maji yamekuwa yakipanda hapa Mathare. Saa hizi daraja la miguu limefunikwa kabisa na watu hawawezi kuvuka.
A fallen tree is blocking two lanes of Thika Superhighway near the Roysambu footbridge. Traffic is building up but no injuries.
A three-storey residential building has collapsed in Kahawa Wendani. People are shouting for help under the rubble. Send rescue teams immediately!
Mama mjamzito anahitaji gari la wagonjwa haraka hapa Kibera, ana uchungu mwingi na damu inatoka. Tafadhali msaidieni!
Mudslide has covered part of the road up in the hills and one matatu is stuck. I do not know the name of this place.
Moto kubwa Karen? Hapana, ni hapa Westlands, jengo moja inachomeka na moshi ni mob. Fire brigade bado kufika.
Our wells in Homa Bay have been dry for three weeks now. Livestock are dying and the borehole queue takes the whole day.
Dhoruba kali imeng'oa mapaa ya nyumba kadhaa hapa Nakuru usiku wa kuamkia leo. Hakuna vifo lakini watu hawana pa kuishi.
About forty families from Budalangi have arrived at the school compound after their homes flooded. They need shelter and clean water.
Kuna uvujaji wa gesi kwenye jengo la ghorofa Westlands, harufu ni kali na walinzi wanawaondoa watu. Hatuhitaji moto hapa!
Just checking if this reporting line works. Everything is fine in my area today, no emergency.
